تستعري (form VIII)
# تَسْتَعِرِي (tastaʕirī) /tas.ta.ʕi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
# تُسْتَعَرِي (tustaʕarī) /tus.ta.ʕa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
